title: Psionic pipeline feeding the UAP legacy program

tellings.quote: I was in a you know psionic development uh pipeline for legacy program development

plain: Jordan Jose, a man who says he was taken into a secret program as a child, says that around 2008 to 2010 in western New York he was placed in "a psionic development pipeline for legacy program development." By this he means a track for training psychic, mind-based abilities in children, meant to feed a long-running hidden government effort on unidentified flying objects. If true, it would mean that effort was quietly recruiting and shaping gifted children.
